mapper.insert:
SELECT LESSON_REPORTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LESSON_REPORTS ( ID, LESSON_ID, CONTENT, NEXT_CHECK ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lessonId}, #{content}, #{nextCheck, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT R.ID, R.LESSON_ID, R.CONTENT, R.NEXT_CHECK, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT FROM LESSON_REPORTS R INNER JOIN LESSONS L ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE R.LESSON_ID = #{lessonId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LESSON_REPORTS SET CONTENT = #{report.content}, NEXT_CHECK = #{report.nextCheck, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_DATE WHERE ID = #{report.id} AND LESSON_ID IN ( SELECT L.ID FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} )
